posts.title: An Obituary for Iliya and Milka
posts.description: Due to the way that our medium functions, we writers have a natural tendency to write about things which people have already written about. This leaves a huge chunk of our job undone — there are a million lines written about rulers, military figures, and other people we dub “successful”, and often zero lines for many good people who are much more worth writing about. And I too (even though I write about concepts, other than people) largely follow tendencies. But this essay will be different. I wouldn’t have known Iliya and Milka if they weren’t my relatives, but I have learned more from them than from any book that I have read, so I want to put at least some of it in print, to celebrate their lives.

posts.title: Entropy
posts.description: Weird places where I encounter the concept of #entropy Value, according to some theory of economics, is created by rearranging the natural resources, given to us in a special way. Computation,(according to computer science) is also the process of arranging some bits of information, according to formulas. There is also the well known biological theory that life is arrangement of matter that beats entropy (see for example “The Animate and the inanimate”) In all three places everything is all about arrangement!
